summary: Ocugen filed an 8-K announcing a private offering of $115M (plus $15M option) of 6.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2034, expected to close May 7, 2026. Net proceeds ~$99.5M (or ~$112.6M if option exercised) will repay $32.7M in outstanding loan obligations. The notes are unregistered, sold to QIBs via Rule 144A. This is a debt capital raise not an acquisition/divestiture; it involves a liability management component with part of proceeds earmarked for debt repayment. Classified as Capital Returns because the primary use is deleveraging via repayment, though the convertible note issuance itself is a financing event. No purchase price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. Watch for market reaction to potential dilution upon conversion and if the option is exercised.
